title: 반말 ↔ 존댓말: 언제, 어떻게 바꿔 말해요?
objective: By the end, you can change short everyday sentences from 반말 to 해요 style and back, and tell who suggested switching to 반말.
summary: This worksheet shows how to change everyday sentences between 반말 and 해요 style.
note: Polite speech on this sheet means the 해요 style, the one most often used in daily life.

task.title: Switch the speech style
task.line: Read each situation, then rewrite, choose, fill in, or answer as each question asks.

sections.heading: Why switching matters
paragraphs: In English, you can sound polite by adding "please" or "sir." In Korean, the ending of almost every sentence changes, and so do small words like "I," "you," and "yes." Switching is a sign of how close two people are, not just grammar.
Don't switch to 반말 on your own. Wait until the other person offers. Usually the older person or the one with the higher position offers first. If you are not sure, 해요 is always the safe choice.

sections.heading: 말 놓기: From 존댓말 to 반말

steps.en: asking someone's age or birth year

items.text: Use 응 only with close people. Use 네 with anyone you speak to politely.
아니 alone sounds casual. Add 요 when you are being polite.
items.example: 아니, 안 바빠. → 아니요, 안 바빠요.

items.text: In polite speech, use the humble word for yourself.
Polite speech avoids a word for "you." Use the person's name with 씨, or their title.
Add 요 to the casual ending.
After a noun, change 야/이야 to 예요/이에요.
A polite suggestion uses -아요/어요, or the softer -(으)ㄹ까요?
For a request, change 줘 to 주세요.
items.example: 문 좀 열어 줘. → 문 좀 열어 주세요.

exercises: Change to polite 해요 style (to a coworker): ① 나 지금 집에 가. ② 이거 누구 거야?
Change to 반말 (to a close friend): ① 내일 시간 있어요? ② 제가 커피 살게요.
Read the chat and answer in English. Who is older, and who suggested using 반말? — 지수: 민호 씨, 몇 년생이에요? / 민호: 98년생이에요. / 지수: 아, 저는 96년생이에요. 말 편하게 해도 돼요? / 민호: 네, 그럼요. / 지수: 고마워, 민호야!
Fill in the blanks with the right words for "you" and "my" (talking to a coworker named 지영): ____도 같이 갈래요? ____ 차로 가요.
Rewrite politely (to an older coworker): ① 우리 여기서 좀 쉬자. ② 그 파일 좀 보내 줘. ③ 아니, 안 추워.
answers: ① 저 지금 집에 가요. ② 이거 누구 거예요?
① 내일 시간 있어? ② 내가 커피 살게.
지수 is older (born in '96; 민호 was born in '98). 지수 suggested it.
① (우리) 여기서 좀 쉬어요. / (우리) 여기서 좀 쉴까요? ② 그 파일 좀 보내 주세요. ③ 아니요, 안 추워요.
